title: Conservative assimilator for batching & KV-cache recommendations
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and implement a conservative, auditable "assimilator" that can safely apply recommended batching and KV-cache configuration changes from Optimize. The assimilator performs staged activation with strict telemetry checks, operator-acknowledged checkpoints, and automatic rollback on deviation from SLO/quality thresholds. Focus areas: policy-driven staging, small-percentage traffic canaries, deterministic replay for verification, and an operator-facing remediation checklist.
acceptance_criteria: A policy engine can declare a suggestion eligible for assimilator processing based on labels and whitelist rules
Traffic partition canary rollout supports 0.5%, 2%, and 10% cohorts with programmable hold durations
Automated telemetry checks detect token-latency regressions >10% or error-rate increases >0.5% and trigger rollback
Operator UI shows a single-step approve/hold/reject control and an exportable runbook
All applied changes are stamped with commit metadata, and there's a replayable audit entry linking telemetry, PR, and rollback actions
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Dry-run synthesis (internal shadow) for 48h on 5% of production-like traffic
Phase 1: Graduated canary 0.5% for 30m, hold, evaluate telemetry checks
Phase 2: Expand to 2% for 2h with operator review, enable automatic rollback on breach
Phase 3: 10% for 6h then global if stable
Fallback: Immediate circuit-breaker to previous config plus notification and incident channel
canary_policy_notes: Use deterministic hashing on customer_id to ensure cohort stability
Prefer region-aware cohorts to limit blast radius in single cloud region
Apply only one suggestion-family (batching or kvcache) per canary to isolate impact
Require concurrent A/B prompt-set evaluation for a small set of golden prompts
tradeoffs_and_decisions: Chose operator-acknowledged holds over fully autonomous progression to reduce false-positive escalation
Conservative thresholds (10% latency, 0.5% error) to prioritize availability over incremental cost savings initially
Delayed machine-learning-driven thresholding to a later iteration to keep initial scope manageable
Audit trail fidelity prioritized over minimal storage cost; store 30d of full telemetry links
engineering_notes: Will leverage existing rollout-controller library and extend hooks for optimize-suggestion metadata
Need new telemetry predicates in console-telemetry to express composite checks (latency+err+quality)
Implement canary cohorts as immutable routing rules to simplify rollback semantics
Integration tests should include synthetic spike and token-distribution skew scenarios
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Misapplied batching increases tail latency. Mitigation: hold durations and golden prompt checks before expansion
Risk: Config drift between Dedicated and Private. Mitigation: tenant-aware policy gates and explicit opt-out for private customers
Risk: Too many simultaneous auto-applications. Mitigation: global rate limiter and operator quota
